assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
The service is medically necessary to distinguish cardiac causes of syncope
The service cannot be considered merely bundled
The service directly addresses intermittent symptoms not captured by standard monitoring
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is I48.0
The diagnosis of recurrent episodes of syncope is R55
The cardiac event monitoring study is coded as CPT 93271
The service is denied because it is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable under current policy guidelines
No reimbursement will be issued for this specific line item
The patient has the right to file an appeal
The appeal must be submitted within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement
Failure to appeal within the designated period may result in the finalization of the denial
